t: A machine used to $(6)plant$() crops and saplings. $(br2)The 9 internal inventory slots are $(6)color$() coded and correspond to the colored markings on the top of the Plant Sower. The working area above the machine is divided into 9 segments and only seeds from the corresponding inventory slot will be planted in each section.
一台用于$(6)种植$()作物和树苗的机器。$(br2)其内部 9 个容器槽位采用$(6)颜色$()编码，并与植物播种机顶部的彩色标记一一对应。机器上方的工作区域被划分为 9 个区段，只有对应容器槽位中的种子才会种植在对应区域内。
